verdict.rationale: Sandbox0's docs describe each sandbox as an "isolated cloud computer" and say it can run its own Docker daemon, which points to strong per-sandbox isolation. However, nothing in the pack names the isolation mechanism (microVM, hypervisor, gVisor or similar) or documents a hard boundary from the host or other tenants. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the isolation technology (microVM or equivalent), a description of the security boundary and threat model, independent or hands-on corroboration of isolation strength.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can rely on a documented hard isolation boundary (microVM or equivalent) between sandboxes and my systems

citations.quote: A sandbox gives a user's AI agent an isolated cloud computer where it can run code, install software, manage files, and control network access.
Docker in Sandbox lets a Sandbox0 Cloud sandbox run a Docker daemon inside the sandbox.
